# Workspace instructions

For every new feature in this PDF chat application, and any task that changes or validates it, follow the mandatory skill-first workflow in [the PDF Chat Engineer agent](./agents/pdf-chat.agent.md): prepare reusable skill guidance first (create a dedicated skill or expand the existing applicable skill), register each new skill in the agent's `Available skills` list and `.github/skills.md`, read and review all applicable `SKILL.md` files, and map their requirements to implementation and tests **before changing application code**. Do not postpone skill preparation, registration, or review until after implementation. This applies even when another agent is selected.

For unrelated workspace tasks, these PDF-specific instructions do not apply.
